# AOM crop pilot semantic distributions

Generated SKOS JSON-LD and Turtle for architecture validation only.

Concept IDs are stable internal ERA identifiers expressed as `urn:era:*` in
semantic files. They are not the deferred public HTTPS concept namespace and
must not be advertised as permanent resolvable URLs.

Regenerate:

```sh
Rscript scripts/build_semantic.R data/pilot dist/pilot
```
